# Third-party logos

The original SVGs in this directory are preserved as downloaded. The cards in
`../tools/` embed those SVGs and add a background and a text label. Rebuild them
with `python3 scripts/build-tool-logos.py` from the repository root.

- Language and infrastructure logos: [Devicon](https://github.com/devicons/devicon),
  from `icons/<tool>/`, under the MIT license. See `devicon/LICENSE`.
- AI tool logos: [Lobe Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), from
  `packages/static-svg/icons/`, under the MIT license. See `lobe-icons/LICENSE`.

Retrieved on 2026-11-08. Brand names and logos identify the corresponding tools;
no affiliation or endorsement is implied.
